lines.en: label secondbeach7:
{i}Meanwhile...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……{/i}

lines.en: scene utaiobeach1
Two girls on a-
lines.zh: 两个女生在——

lines.en: Oh, fuck it. You get the point already.
lines.zh: 哦，去他的。你们懂的。

lines.en: The thing is, these two are a little different from the rest.
lines.zh: 问题是，这两个人和其他人有点不一样。

lines.en: But how, you ask?
lines.zh: 哪儿不一样，你问？

lines.en: Why, that would be a question to ask either of them. Not me.
lines.zh: 哎呀，那该去问她们俩中的任何一个。别问我。

lines.en: I’m just a bystander.
lines.zh: 我只是个旁观者。

lines.en: A voice or a thought carried in on a snowflake, melting before I have the chance to kiss the ground.
lines.zh: 一个声音，或是一缕念头，被一片雪花捎来，在我有机会亲吻大地之前便融化了。

lines.en: Then, just as I’m about to get a taste of what it is to be real, I become ephemeral.
lines.zh: 然后，就在我快要尝到「真实」是何种滋味的那一刻，我变得转瞬即逝。

lines.en: And I evaporate.
lines.zh: 接着我蒸发了。

lines.en: But that’s a good thing.
lines.zh: 但这是件好事。

lines.en: Because it means I get to spend more time with you.
lines.zh: 因为这意味着我会有更多时间陪着你。

lines.en: : It’s been a while since I’ve seen you with your hair down.
lines.zh: ：好久没见你把头发放下来了。

lines.en: : Does it look weird?
lines.zh: ：看起来很奇怪吗？

lines.en: : ‘Course not.
lines.zh: ：当然不。

lines.en: : Want me to teach you how to do my braid thingy so we can be twins?
lines.zh: ：要不要我教你编我这个辫子，这样我们就是双胞胎啦？

lines.en: : I think I’d need to grow a few more sizes before we could really be called that, Uta.
lines.zh: ：我觉得我得再长大几个号，我们才算得上是双胞胎吧，Uta。

lines.en: : You’d have to put on a few pounds, too. I haven’t had my ribs showing like yours since back in elementary[school].
lines.zh: ：你还得多长几斤肉才行。我从小学[school]那会儿之后，肋骨就再没像你这样一根根突出来过了。

lines.en: : Heheh...you were even skinnier than me back then.
lines.zh: ：嘿嘿……你那时候比我还瘦呢。

lines.en: : Alas, what puberty does to a [young_girl]’s body.
lines.zh: ：唉，这就是青春期对 [young_girl] 的身体做的事啊。

lines.en: : Or {i}doesn’t{/i} in my case.
lines.zh: ：或者说，在我身上{i}什么都没做成{/i}。

lines.en: : What’s the rush, girl? It’s not like we’re goin’ anywhere anytime soon.
lines.zh: ：急什么呀，丫头？我们又不会马上就跑到哪儿去。

lines.en: : You’ve got all of [high_school] to worry about puttin’ some meat on those bones.
lines.zh: ：你还有整个 [high_school] 可以操心怎么往那身骨头上贴点肉呢。

lines.en: scene utaiobeach2
: I guess so.
lines.zh: ：大概吧。

lines.en: : I mean, there are kind of...bigger things to worry about right now anyway.
lines.zh: ：我是说，反正现在还有……更要紧的事要操心。

lines.en: : Have somethin’ on your mind? You know you can always talk to me if there’s somethin’ troublin’ ya.
lines.zh: ：有心事？你知道的，要是有什么烦着你的事，随时都能跟我说。

lines.en: : Yeah...I just...
lines.zh: ：嗯……我只是……

lines.en: : I really like Sensei, Uta.
lines.zh: ：我真的很喜欢 Sensei，Uta。

lines.en: scene utaiobeach3
: Ah.
: Yeah, I know you do.
lines.zh: ：嗯，我知道你喜欢。

lines.en: : You two would be cute together.
lines.zh: ：你们两个在一起会挺可爱的。

lines.en: : I don’t really think that “cute” is a term that either of us strive for.
lines.zh: ：我倒不觉得「可爱」是我俩谁会去追求的词。

lines.en: : But things are a little less...horrible when I’m with him.
lines.zh: ：但和他在一起的时候，事情就没那么……糟糕了。

lines.en: : Which probably makes me sound overly dependent and moronic given that I’ve known him for less than a[school] year, but you know how my brain works and blah blah blah Io stuff.
lines.zh: ：考虑到我认识他还不到一个[school]学年，这话说出来大概显得我特别依赖人、特别蠢，但你了解我脑子是怎么转的，呜哩哇啦一堆 Io 的老毛病。

lines.en: : I’m just kinda nervous, you know?
lines.zh: ：我就是有点紧张，你懂吧？

lines.en: : He’s so cool and I’m so...shitty.
lines.zh: ：他那么好，而我却这么……烂。

lines.en: : I just wish there was something I could do to-
lines.zh: ：我只是希望我能做点什么来——

lines.en: : It might help to be a little less self-deprecating every now and then.
lines.zh: ：你偶尔少贬自己两句，说不定会有帮助。

lines.en: scene utaiobeach4
: Hm?
: I...just mean that Sensei probably gets a little annoyed having to hear you always talking down about yourself!
lines.zh: ：我……只是说，Sensei 老是听你把自己说得一文不值，大概也会有点烦吧！

lines.en: : I know what you mean, and I’m fully aware of that as well. You’re just not normally as direct when it comes to criticizing my flaws.
lines.zh: ：我知道你什么意思，我也完全清楚这一点。只是你平时批评我的缺点时，一般不这么直白。

lines.en: scene utaiobeach5
: No...I’m not, am I?
lines.zh: ：是哦……我平时不这样，对吧？

lines.en: : Uh-oh. Looks like Uta might {i}also{/i} need somebody to talk to.
lines.zh: ：哎呀。看来 Uta 自己{i}也{/i}需要找人聊聊了。

lines.en: : Is it time to relive one of our famous late night vents from the old chat room?
lines.zh: ：是不是该重温一下我们当年在那个老聊天室里著名的深夜倾诉了？

lines.en: : I don’t really want to get into anything that deep, Io. It’s still a vacation after all.
lines.zh: ：我不想聊那么深的东西，Io。毕竟现在还在度假呢。

lines.en: : And we’re not really the same people we were back then.
lines.zh: ：而且我们也不再是当年那两个人了。

lines.en: : Hmm...
scene utaiobeach6
: I disagree.
lines.zh: ：我不这么认为。

lines.en: : I think that, to some extent, people never really change.
lines.zh: ：我觉得，在某种程度上，人是永远不会真正改变的。

lines.en: : Sure, you can learn to handle some things differently...and learn to approach problems in more constructive ways.
lines.zh: ：当然，你可以学着用不同的方式去处理一些事……学着用更有建设性的方式去面对问题。

lines.en: : But we’re all still products of our upbringing and the experiences we had during the most impressionable times of our childhood.
lines.zh: ：但我们始终是自身成长的产物，是童年最容易受影响的那些年里所经历之事的产物。

lines.en: : Which is part of why I’ll always think I’m worthless and why you’ll always-
lines.zh: ：这也是为什么我永远都会觉得自己一无是处，而你永远都会——

lines.en: : I’m not really in the mood to be analyzed right now, Io.
lines.zh: ：我现在没心情被你分析，Io。

lines.en: : Besides...you wanted to talk about Sensei, didn’t you?
lines.zh: ：再说……你本来是想聊 Sensei 的吧？

lines.en: : About how...cool he is or whatever it was you said?
lines.zh: ：聊他有多……好，还是你刚才说的什么来着？

lines.en: : He’s great.
lines.zh: ：他很好。

lines.en: : He listens to me and understands me.
lines.zh: ：他会听我说话，也理解我。

lines.en: : Or at least I think he understands me. I’m so all over the place that I don’t think anyone will ever be able to pick up on 100%% of my bullshit.
lines.zh: ：至少我觉得他是理解我的。我这人太乱七八糟了，我不觉得有谁能 100%% 地接住我那些狗屁玩意儿。

lines.en: : And...I don’t know. I just feel like there’s this deep sort of connection there despite the two of us having never done anything to truly {i}connect{/i} with one another.
lines.zh: ：而且……我也不知道。我只是觉得，尽管我们两个从来没做过什么真正把彼此{i}连起来{/i}的事，但那里确实存在某种很深的联系。

lines.en: : And I guess...that last part is what I’m more worried about than anything.
lines.zh: ：我猜……最后那部分，才是我最担心的。

lines.en: scene utaiobeach7
: Does that...mean what I think it means?
lines.zh: ：这……是我想的那个意思吗？

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: ：大概是吧。

lines.en: : Sensei’s...kind of really perverted.
lines.zh: ：Sensei……挺变态的。

lines.en: : And...
lines.zh: ：而且……

lines.en: : Well...
scene utaiobeach8
: I get it.
lines.zh: ：我懂了。

lines.en: : I understand you better than anyone, so I know that comin’ out and talkin’ about all that’s just gonna make both of us feel like puddles of...grossness.
lines.zh: ：我比谁都了解你，所以我知道把那些事说出来，只会让我们两个都觉得自己像一滩……恶心吧唧的东西。

lines.en: : Remember what we learned back then- the best thing to do is face forward. Don’t let your stupid brain or the stupid world bring you down.
lines.zh: ：还记得我们当年学到的话吗——最好的做法就是面朝前方。别让你那蠢脑子或者这个蠢世界把你拖垮。

lines.en: scene utaiobeach9
: This is starting to get into chat room territory after all.
lines.zh: ：这到底还是聊到聊天室那一套了。

lines.en: : Specifically the fun times in the chat room. Without all the venting about our problems and more of all the stuff we planned on doing together once we finally met.
lines.zh: ：而且是聊天室里那些开心的部分。不倒苦水，不抱怨问题，多聊聊我们终于见面之后打算一起做的那些事。

lines.en: : Heheh...we still haven’t gone to a baseball game together.
lines.zh: ：嘿嘿……我们还没一起去看过棒球赛呢。

lines.en: : Or the zoo!
lines.zh: ：还有动物园！

lines.en: : Or a professional wrestling match.
lines.zh: ：还有职业摔角比赛。

lines.en: : Or another zoo!
lines.zh: ：还有另一个动物园！

lines.en: scene utaiobeach10
: Why did I ever think you were a boy when all you wanted to do was go to different zoos?
lines.zh: ：你明明只想逛各种各样的动物园，我当初怎么会觉得你是个男生呢？

lines.en: : Idunno. I probably told you I had short hair or something back then and you just ran with it cause that’s what you wanted me to be.
lines.zh: ：谁知道呢。大概我当时跟你说过我留短发什么的，你就顺着那话自己脑补了，因为那本来就是你希望我成为的样子。

lines.en: : Also, boys can go to zoos, Io. For all we know, Sensei loves the zoo.
lines.zh: ：再说，男生也能去动物园啊，Io。说不定 Sensei 就爱逛动物园呢。

lines.en: scene utaiobeach11
: Heheh...maybe he does.
lines.zh: ：嘿嘿……也许他真的喜欢。

lines.en: : I think I still want to go alone with you before we let him tag along, though. We’ve kind of had plans for years already, so it wouldn’t be fair to make him the third wheel.
lines.zh: ：不过我还是想先跟你两个人去，再让他跟着。我们早就计划好多年了，让他来当电灯泡也不公平。

lines.en: : That’s right! Hoes before bros!
lines.zh: ：没错！婊子优先，兄弟靠边！

lines.en: : Don’t call us that. It’s a derogatory term that reduces the two of us to mindless bimbos instead of the sweet, fun-loving girls we actually are.
lines.zh: ：别这么叫我们。这是个贬义词，会把我们俩贬成没脑子的花瓶，而不是我们实际上的那种又甜又爱玩的女孩。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Sisters before misters?
lines.zh: ：姐妹优先，先生靠边？

lines.en: : Heheh...I like that one a lot more.
lines.zh: ：嘿嘿……这个说法我更喜欢。

lines.en: scene utaiobeach1
: Hey...Uta?
lines.zh: ：喂……Uta？

lines.en: : Yeah?
lines.zh: ：怎么啦？

lines.en: : I’m kind of glad you convinced me to come along this weekend.
lines.zh: ：我有点庆幸你劝我这周末一起来了。

lines.en: : Thank you.
lines.zh: ：谢谢你。

lines.en: : Don’t thank me yet. We still haven’t gotten to the sleepover part, and that’s probably gonna be harder than anything for you.
lines.zh: ：先别急着谢。过夜那一关我们还没到呢，对你来说那大概比什么都难。

lines.en: : I am glad you’re here, though.
lines.zh: ：不过我很高兴你在这儿。

lines.en: : Even if you probably wouldn’t have come if it was just me and not Sensei.
lines.zh: ：哪怕如果只有我、没有 Sensei，你大概根本不会来。

lines.en: : You say that, but here I am watching the sunset with you instead of going around and searching for him.
lines.zh: ：你这么说，可我现在正陪你看日落，而不是到处去找他。

lines.en: : What can I say? I’m just as popular with the ladies as I am with the men.
lines.zh: ：我能说什么呢？我在女生里的受欢迎程度就跟在男生里一样高。

lines.en: : You do get a surprising amount of female customers at the maid cafe.
lines.zh: ：你在女仆咖啡店确实有相当多的女客人。

lines.en: : There are a surprising amount of females in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: ：Kumon-mi 的女的多得惊人。

lines.en: : Also a good point.
lines.zh: ：也说得对。

lines.en: : Do you ever think about how life would be if it were the other way around? If it was all the women who disappeared instead?
lines.zh: ：你有没有想过，如果情况反过来会怎么样？如果消失的是所有女人呢？

lines.en: : I think I would be making significantly more money to spend on a variety of sugary cereals.
lines.zh: ：那我大概能赚多得多的钱，用来买各种各样的甜麦片。

lines.en: : You should probably learn to be a little more careful with your paychecks, Uta.
lines.zh: ：你大概该学着对你的工资上点心了，Uta。

lines.en: : I have a problem.
lines.zh: ：我这人有毛病。

lines.en: : I do think it’d be...different, though.
lines.zh: ：不过我确实觉得……会不一样。

lines.en: : I think a world like that would be a little better for you and...a heck of a lot worse for me.
lines.zh: ：我觉得那样的世界对你来说会好一点……对我来说则糟糕得多。

lines.en: scene utaiobeach12
: Probably. You’re definitely the type that guys tend to fawn over.
lines.zh: ：大概吧。你绝对是那种男生容易围着献殷勤的类型。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t be worried about that part. If there’s anything I’m confident about that isn’t attached to my torso, it’s the ability to dodge boys.
lines.zh: ：我倒不担心这个。除了挂在胸口的那些东西之外，我唯一还有自信的，就是躲开男生的本事。

lines.en: : What I’d be scared of would be the whole issue of...figuring out who I am.
lines.zh: ：我害怕的是……搞清楚自己是谁这件事。

lines.en: : I’ve only been a “girly” girl for a really small part of my life. And it’s not like I figured out how to do that all on my own.
lines.zh: ：我这一生里，当「女孩子气的女孩」的时间其实很短。而且那也不是我自己一个人摸索出来的。

lines.en: : I learned from other girls and stuff. Just saw what they were doing and...voila.
lines.zh: ：我是跟别的女生学的之类的。看着她们怎么做，然后……就成了。

lines.en: : But I like it.
lines.zh: ：但我喜欢。

lines.en: : I like this version of me.
lines.zh: ：我喜欢现在这个版本的我。

lines.en: : I like this version of you too.
lines.zh: ：我也喜欢现在这个版本的你。

lines.en: : How much would you say you like it on a scale of one to Sensei?
lines.zh: ：如果以 Sensei 为满分来打分，你有多喜欢？

lines.en: : Definitely Sensei.
lines.zh: ：那肯定是 Sensei。

lines.en: : In fact, probably even more since I know you aren’t trying to get into my pants.
lines.zh: ：事实上可能还更喜欢你一点，因为我知道你没打算脱我的裤子。

lines.en: scene utaiobeach13
: But Io, you aren’t {i}wearing{/i} pants right now. Does that mean it's okay?
lines.zh: ：可是 Io，你现在没{i}穿{/i}裤子啊。那是不是就说明可以了？

lines.en: : You know, maybe I should knock you down to a nine or something instead?
lines.zh: ：你知道吗，也许我该把你降到九分什么的？

lines.en: : Sexual intercourse before marriage is a sin.
lines.zh: ：婚前的性行为是罪过。

lines.en: : Your limbs will fall off and dissolve into the sand.
lines.zh: ：你们的四肢会脱落，融进沙子里。

lines.en: : Did you hear that just now?
lines.zh: ：你刚才听见了吗？

lines.en: scene utaiobeach14
: Yup...
: Oh! Yasuyasu’s here! What a...delightful surprise!
lines.zh: ：哦！Yasuyasu 来了！真是个……令人愉快的惊喜！

lines.en: : Do not be delighted to be visited by a mere worm like me. I am simply scouring the sands in search of decaying plant matter to feast upon.
lines.zh: ：不要因为区区一条蛆虫如我造访而感到欣喜。我只是在沙地里翻找腐烂的植物碎屑，好大快朵颐。

lines.en: : Did uhh...did Noriko convince you to go vegetarian or something?
lines.zh: ：呃……是 Noriko 说服你改吃素了还是怎么的？

lines.en: scene utaiobeach15
: I beg your pardon?
lines.zh: ：你说什么？

lines.en: : Umm...don’t worry about it. Just a little confused by the whole...plant matter thingy.
lines.zh: ：嗯……别在意。就是有点搞不懂那个……植物碎屑的事。

lines.en: : You...wanna sit down with us maybe? We’re kinda just killin’ time before goin’ back to the room for dinner.
lines.zh: ：你……要不要跟我们坐下聊聊？我们也就是在回房间吃晚饭前打发打发时间。

lines.en: : You’re inviting {i}me{/i} to sit with you? Is that really okay?
lines.zh: ：你在邀请{i}我{/i}和你们坐在一起？真的可以吗？

lines.en: scene utaiobeach16
: I mean...as long as Io is okay with it, I don’t really mind. It’ll definitely...liven up the conversation at least.
lines.zh: ：我是说……只要 Io 没意见，我是不介意。至少肯定……能让话题热闹点。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: I guess it’s okay?
lines.zh: ：应该可以吧？

lines.en: : I don’t really count Yasu as a human, so there’s not really anything for me to despise apart from the whole religious fanatic thing.
lines.zh: ：我本来就不把 Yasu 当人类看，所以除了那个宗教狂热的部分，我其实也没什么可讨厌的。

lines.en: : Do you dislike God, Io?
lines.zh: ：你讨厌神吗，Io？

lines.en: : It’s not possible to dislike something that doesn’t actually exist.
lines.zh: ：人不可能去讨厌一个根本不存在的东西。

lines.en: : But what if I can prove He does?
lines.zh: ：可如果我能证明祂存在呢？

lines.en: : You can’t. Countless people have attempted to prove the existence of divine beings and each and every effort has been not only incredibly flawed, but-
lines.zh: ：你证明不了。无数人试图证明神明的存在，而每一次尝试不仅漏洞百出，而且——

lines.en: scene utaiobeach17
: I’m bored! Let’s talk about something that I can understand instead!
lines.zh: ：我无聊了！我们换个我听得懂的话题吧！

lines.en: : I’d be more than willing to teach you if-
lines.zh: ：我非常乐意为你讲解，如果——

lines.en: : I’m good!
lines.zh: ：不用了！

lines.en: : Plop that booty down right next to me and talk about something other than God for a change, Yasuyasu.
lines.zh: ：把你的屁股往我旁边一放，换个神以外的话题聊聊吧，Yasuyasu。

lines.en: scene utaiobeach18
: Something...other than God?
lines.zh: ：神……以外的话题？

lines.en: : Do I know anything else?
lines.zh: ：我还知道别的事吗？

lines.en: : You’ve gotta know {i}something{/i} else.
lines.zh: ：你肯定还知道{i}点别的{/i}。

lines.en: : Like...maybe some hobbies? Or a TV show you like that you never really get to talk about?
lines.zh: ：比如……什么爱好？或者你喜欢但从来没机会聊的电视节目？

lines.en: : Me and Io watch a lot of TV together, so there’s a pretty good chance we’ve seen whatever you’re into.
lines.zh: ：我和 Io 一起看了很多电视，所以你喜欢的东西我们很可能也看过。

lines.en: : I don’t watch TV. The frequency of the sound and color of the light causes my brain to shake in ways that make me feel a great deal of pain.
lines.zh: ：我不看电视。声音的频率和光的颜色会让我的大脑以某种方式震颤，给我带来极大的痛苦。

lines.en: : Ooooooookay. Then how about food? Do you have a favorite?
lines.zh: ：好——吧。那食物呢？你有最喜欢的吗？

lines.en: : A favorite food...
lines.zh: ：最喜欢的食物……

lines.en: scene utaiobeach19
: Strawberry daifuku.
lines.zh: ：草莓大福。

lines.en: : Ah! A real answer! And a really cute one at that!
lines.zh: ：啊！一个真正的答案！而且还特别可爱！

lines.en: : That is...not the answer I was expecting.
lines.zh: ：这……可不是我预期的答案。

lines.en: : What were you expecting, Io?
lines.zh: ：你预期的是什么，Io？

lines.en: : I don’t know...Maybe the...blood of angels or something?
lines.zh: ：我不知道……也许是……天使的血之类的？

lines.en: : Why ever would I consume the life essence of what I aspire to become? That’s just silly.
lines.zh: ：我为什么要吞下自己渴望成为之物的生命精华？那也太蠢了。

lines.en: scene utaiobeach20
: Yasuyasu, tell me somethin’ else you like. Another girly thing.
lines.zh: ：Yasuyasu，再告诉我一件你喜欢的事。另一件女孩子气的事。

lines.en: : Like...tell me how you feel about love!
lines.zh: ：比如……说说你对恋爱有什么感觉！

lines.en: : Love?
lines.zh: ：恋爱？

lines.en: : Yeah! Like...what kinda boys do you like? Or girls. We ain’t judgin’ here.
lines.zh: ：对啊！比如……你喜欢什么样的男生？或者女生。我们这儿不评判人的。

lines.en: : I’m not quite sure.
lines.zh: ：我不太确定。

lines.en: : I can’t say I’ve ever known someone long enough to feel an emotion as strong as that.
lines.zh: ：我还从没认识谁久到足以产生那么强烈的感情。

lines.en: : Not even like a family member you joked about marrying or something?
lines.zh: ：连那种你开玩笑说要嫁了的家人之类的都没有？

lines.en: : Family?
lines.zh: ：家人？

lines.en: : Yeah. Your mom must’ve told you about love at some point, right?
lines.zh: ：对啊。你妈妈总在某个时候跟你讲过恋爱的事吧？

lines.en: : I’m afraid I don’t have a mother.
lines.zh: ：恐怕我没有母亲。

lines.en: scene utaiobeach21
: Oh...crap. I’m sorry.
lines.zh: ：哦……操。对不起。

lines.en: : This is what I get for choosing two conversation topics in a row, isn’t it?
lines.zh: ：这就是我连着挑两个话题的下场，对吧？

lines.en: : You’ve got Touka, though, right?
lines.zh: ：不过你有 Touka 啊，对吧？

lines.en: : I’m sure that she’s probably asked you something similar in the past. You two are basically attached at the hip, aren't you?
lines.zh: ：我敢说她以前大概问过你类似的问题。你们俩基本形影不离，不是吗？

lines.en: : I suppose that Touka is like a mother to me.
lines.zh: ：我想 Touka 对我来说就像母亲一样。

lines.en: : Not really what I was going for, but sure. Let’s run with that.
lines.zh: ：不完全是我要表达的意思，不过行吧。就这么说吧。

lines.en: scene utaiobeach22
: She is a good person.
lines.zh: ：她是个好人。

lines.en: : Pure of heart and mind.
lines.zh: ：心灵与思想都纯洁无瑕。

lines.en: : A true virgin both physically and spiritually.
lines.zh: ：无论肉体上还是精神上，都是真正的处女。

lines.en: : Uta, change the topic again.
lines.zh: ：Uta，再换个话题。

lines.en: : Are you kidding? I wanna see where this goes.
lines.zh: ：你开玩笑吧？我想看看她还能说出什么。

lines.en: : A person like her would be better suited for this conversation.
lines.zh: ：像她那样的人，才更适合这场对话。

lines.en: : She possesses both the freedom of thought and an unearthly desire to belong. To love and to be loved.
lines.zh: ：她既拥有思想的自由，又有着超乎尘世的、想要归属的渴望。想要去爱，也想要被爱。

lines.en: : I possess none of that.
lines.zh: ：这些我一样都没有。

lines.en: : I am a vessel. Incapable of feeling or wanting those things.
lines.zh: ：我是一件器皿。无法感受，也无法渴求那些东西。

lines.en: : Existing for the sole purpose of filling myself with light and pouring it over the heads of those willing to be drenched in His love.
lines.zh: ：我存在的唯一目的，就是让自己盛满光，再把光浇在那些愿意被祂的爱淋透的人头上。

lines.en: : Slipping silently into sermons, scalding each surrounding servant with seed stripped from sinful serpents.
lines.zh: ：无声地滑进布道之中，用从有罪的蛇身上剥下的种子，灼伤四周环绕的仆人。

lines.en: : Singeing the skin of those sleeping in shadows by singing the praises of the smile in the sky.
lines.zh: ：借着歌颂天空中那抹微笑，将那些睡在阴影里的人的皮肤烤焦。

lines.en: : These are the reasons I exist.
lines.zh: ：这些就是我存在的理由。

lines.en: : Not to love. Not to feel. Not to want.
lines.zh: ：不是为了去爱。不是为了去感受。不是为了去渴求。

lines.en: : But to be. And become.
lines.zh: ：而是为了存在。为了成为。

lines.en: : And to save. And to be saved.
lines.zh: ：为了拯救。为了被拯救。

lines.en: : All I want is for the world to smile together, all at once.
lines.zh: ：我唯一想要的，就是让全世界在同一刻一起微笑。

lines.en: : That is all He wants as well.
lines.zh: ：那也是祂唯一的愿望。

lines.en: : But there is so much darkness.
lines.zh: ：可是黑暗太多了。

lines.en: : And not just in the world itself, but in everyone.
lines.zh: ：不只是这世界本身，而是每个人心里都有。

lines.en: : In each of you.
lines.zh: ：你们每个人心里都有。

lines.en: : It will swallow you whole, you know.
lines.zh: ：它会把你们整个吞下去，你们知道的。

lines.en: : Maybe not now. Maybe not tomorrow.
lines.zh: ：也许不是现在。也许不是明天。

lines.en: : But there will come a time when you are forced to face what you fear the most.
lines.zh: ：但总有一天，你们会被迫直面自己最害怕的东西。

lines.en: : And when that time comes, I will be right around the corner- with open arms and a sanctuary for you to lose yourself in when you think there’s nothing {i}left{/i} to lose.
lines.zh: ：而那一天到来时，我就会在拐角处等着——张开双臂，还有一座圣所，供你迷失其中，当你以为自己已经没有什么可以{i}再失去{/i}的时候。

lines.en: scene utaiobeach23
: I’m sorry. What was the question again?
lines.zh: ：抱歉。刚才的问题是什么来着？
：我们……

lines.en: : We just wanted to know what you thought about love.
lines.zh: ：我们只是想知道你对恋爱怎么看。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: ：原来如此。

lines.en: scene utaiobeach22
: I think love is lovely.
lines.zh: ：我觉得恋爱很美好。

lines.en: scene black
Three girls in a line on the beach.
lines.zh: 三个女生在海滩上排成一条线。

lines.en: One callous-
lines.zh: 一个冷漠——

lines.en: And two others.
lines.zh: 还有另外两个。

lines.en: But is there truly an issue with callousness in and of itself?
lines.zh: 可是冷漠本身，真的有什么问题吗？

lines.en: And couldn’t such an adjective change based on your perception of it?
lines.zh: 而这个形容词，难道不会随着你对它的看法而改变吗？

lines.en: If you want my opinion, the answer is yes.
lines.zh: 如果你想听我的意见，答案是肯定的。

lines.en: My opinion is that everything can change. And that everyone’s thoughts can be changed if you try hard enough to actually change them.
lines.zh: 我的意见是，一切都能改变。而且只要你真的足够努力去改变，每个人的想法都能被改变。

lines.en: And so I say to Io Ichimonji, the girl who thinks no one can change, that you are weak.
lines.zh: 所以我要对 Io Ichimonji——那个认为谁都不会改变的女孩子说，你很软弱。

lines.en: And I say to Uta Ushibori, the girl who doesn’t want to think at all, that you, too, are weak.
lines.zh: 我要对 Uta Ushibori——那个根本不想动脑的女孩子说，你也很软弱。

lines.en: And to the girl {s}in the black dress{/s} in the[school] swimsuit-
lines.zh: 还有那个{s}穿着黑裙子{/s}、套着[school]泳衣的女孩——

lines.en: You are the weakest of all.
lines.zh: 你是最软弱的那个。

lines.en: But for reasons quite different than that of the others.
lines.zh: 但原因和其他人的完全不同。

lines.en: The three girls run into the water and never return.
lines.zh: 三个女生跑进海里，再也没有回来。

lines.en: And I fall back into place in the midst of the water cycle, for the storm clouds have drifted slightly off course.
lines.zh: 而我重新落回水循环中的原位，因为风暴云稍稍偏离了航向。

lines.en: Everything is ephemeral.
lines.zh: 一切皆转瞬即逝。

lines.en: Everything is falling.
lines.zh: 一切都在坠落。
